answer.held_back_by: The file ceiling was set at joining (Director), and my one big raise to Deputy Secretary came from a single Y27 choice. answer.ending_fair_why: I maxed integrity, competence and reputation and was still capped by a hidden number, and the game never told me what the political route required. The ending card was nicely written, but the last seven years had no real agency.
answer.chase_next: The political invitation: a Minister or MP sponsor. I would keep up the Meet-the-People Sessions, take credit, and avoid the standing-losing choices early to build STAND above 60.
answer.play_again_why: I haven't cracked the PM route, and I have clear hypotheses to test: STAND, sponsor, early choices.
answer.title_fit_why: The run was about grades, appraisals and quiet competence, and the pay barely mattered. 'Confirmed & Substantive' fits the grind of promotions better than the Minister salary I never reached.
answer.notes_for_next_life: Confirmed: the file has a hidden ceiling (starts at Director). Blunt honesty at Y27 The Counter raised it to Deputy Secretary. The Perm Sec timeline was Y21 with no rung above, so politics is a separate path needing an invitation. I never got one in 38 years despite REP87, INTEG100, COMP100, STAND47. Weekly Meet-the-People at Y30 gave an MP's notice, so try it earlier and more often. STAND is probably the key stat. Raise it by taking credit, getting the team recognised, being seen doing the work, cooperating in inquiries, and announcing then delivering pilots. Avoid whistleblowing reports, concessions, family over work, over-exact budget bids and recusals. Try for STAND 60+ by Y25. Look for sponsor events from MPs or Ministers and accept every one. Years 32-38 mostly had a single choice, so the decisions that matter come before Y31.
